source.title: Campeonato Sudamericano 2013 on January 5-6, 2013 in Arequipa, Peru
source.content: The [Campeonato Sudamericano 2013](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=CampeonatoSudamericano2013) will take place on January 5-6, 2013 in Arequipa, Peru. Check out the [Campeonato Sudamericano 2013 website](http://www.cubingsouthamerica.com/Sudamericano/index.php) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2013 年南美洲锦标赛将于 1 月 5–6 日在秘鲁阿雷基帕举行
translation.content: [2013 年南美洲锦标赛（Campeonato Sudamericano 2013）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=CampeonatoSudamericano2013)将于 2013 年 1 月 5–6 日在秘鲁阿雷基帕举行。更多信息及报名请见[赛事网站](http://www.cubingsouthamerica.com/Sudamericano/index.php)。
